name: Navy Physical Readiness Test (PRT), altitude under 5,000 ft

source.document: Navy Physical Fitness Assessment Guide-5A, Physical Readiness Test, Table 4-1 (performance categories and points by age group and sex)

rule.summary: The PRT is passed with at least a Probationary result (45 points) in every event: push-ups, forearm plank and the 1.5-mile run. The overall PRT score is the category of the average points of the three events. A result below Probationary fails the whole test.

caveat: The alternate cardio events (2-kilometer row, 500-yard and 450-meter swim, stationary bike) and the standards for altitudes above 5,000 feet are not included.
